title: The Old Light F5 - The Gallery of Confident Facts
_note: Old Light floor 5 (pearlmoor_oldlight_5): the hall where Punchwheel states wrong facts with total conviction. Opens on a pompous 2-bar brass fanfare of the motif that MISFIRES - it lands on a confidently wrong Gb chord (Db in the lead) and deflates with a noise blat - then the theme is played with wrong notes held loud and proud: chromatic slips (F#, B natural, Ab) that resolve a beat later, a whole-tone tumble over an augmented C7 in place of the half cadence, a phrase that lurches UP a whole tone into G and back to F as if nothing happened, D minor declared major, and a final run home that overshoots to C# and lands on Gb before correcting to F. Laughs are whole-tone (no home key). Brass doubles the lead an octave down in the fanfare and the B section. 112 BPM, 4/4, F major (allegedly), 26 bars.
